theorems.name: Submission.l2_ball_weak_subsequence
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Rn n), (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1))) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖G k x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 1) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ h : Rn n → Rn n, MemLp h 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, inner ℝ (G (φ k) x) (h x)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, inner ℝ (g x) (h x)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
